subject: Staged adoption & pricing ladder for MAP deliverables
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northpointretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@northpointretail.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged adoption & pricing ladder for MAP deliverables

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the latency and token-cost numbers look promising for our storefront personalization use case. Before we get the procurement and legal teams moving, we need to align on one piece: how the MAP (mutual action plan) milestones map to committed volumes and a pricing ladder during the ramp.

Northpoint's asks:
- A clear monthly tokens/TPM commit cadence for the first 6 months (we expect a fast pilot then scale).
- Discount tiers tied to cumulative commits (not just monthly peaks).
- An evaluation-to-MAP conversion path: how pilot usage credits convert to committed TPM and any offset.
- A short canary ramp (first 30 days) with transparent overage rates and rollback triggers.

Do you have a recommended "pricing staircase" and a sample CANARY ramp we can share with procurement? If we can get a neat table and a draft SOW, we can move to legal quick.

Appreciate it —
Sara
Sara Liu
Head of AI Platform Partnerships
Northpoint Retail

Attachments: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northpointretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged adoption & pricing ladder for MAP deliverables

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. Pushing a short proposal so procurement has something concrete to review. High level below, attached a draft MAP workbook (NPR-MAP-draft.xlsx) with token math and a sample SOW stub.

Summary proposal (first 6 months):
- Month 0 (Pilot): 0 committed TPM, evaluation credits = 2M tokens (applies as credit if converted within 30 days).
- Month 1-2 (Canary): commit 20M tokens/month (baseline canary); overage = $0.004/token; discount = 0% (intro).
- Month 3-4 (Scale): commit 50M tokens/month; cumulative discount tier 5% once cumulative tokens >= 200M.
- Month 5-6 (Production): commit 120M tokens/month; cumulative discount tier 12% at cumulative >= 500M; committed price floor applies.

Pricing ladder (example):
- <200M cumulative: $0.0065/token (list)
- 200M–499M cumulative: $0.0062/token (after 5% discount)
- >=500M cumulative: $0.0057/token (after 12% discount)

Overage rules: monthly overage billed at 1.25x committed price for that month; we can cap overage exposure with a soft cap you can set in the console.

Evaluation credit conversion: evaluation credits (Pilot) can be applied as a monetary credit to the first billed month if NPR signs within 30 days; they do not change committed TPM but reduce the first invoice. If you want pilot usage to count toward cumulative thresholds, we can make an exception — recommend agreeing in writing in the SOW.

Next steps: Marissa will attach the SOW stub and a one-page pricing ladder for procurement. If that looks good, I can generate a DocuSign PowerForm and we can target signature + kick-off call in the week after.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: NPR-MAP-draft.xlsx (workbook with token math and scenarios)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northpointretail.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged adoption & pricing ladder for MAP deliverables

Sara — quick operational clarifications from our side so procurement has clean answers to redlines: 

1) Commit floor vs. burst: are you comfortable with a committed floor per month (as Vivek suggested) plus a burst allowance billed at overage rates? If you prefer a soft-commit (no strict financial penalty but higher overage price) we can flip the model.

2) Pilot conversion counting: Vivek noted we can make pilot tokens count toward cumulative thresholds with a written note in the SOW. That is the simplest from a billing perspective but requires procurement sign-off.

3) Ramp cadence example as monthly TPM targets (we usually model in tokens):
   - Pilot: 0 committed (2M eval credits)
   - Canary M1: 20M tokens
   - Canary M2: 20M tokens
   - Scale M3: 50M tokens
   - Scale M4: 50M tokens
   - Prod M5: 120M tokens
   - Prod M6: 120M tokens

4) SLA exception / rollback: for the first 30 days post-signature we permit a canary rollback window with pro-rated credit for downtime > SLA threshold. Need procurement to confirm desired SLA credit terms.

If you can confirm the commit-floor approach or request soft-commit, we will update the SOW and price ladder and circulate.

Thanks —
Aditya
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northpointretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@northpointretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged adoption & pricing ladder for MAP deliverables

Thanks Vivek/Aditya — this is helpful. A few notes from procurement/legal after quick review: 

- Procurement prefers a soft-commit for the canary (no heavy penalties months 1–2) and then a binding commit starting month 3. That means overage tiers in M1–M2 should be reasonable (we suggest <= 1.5x list).
- We want pilot tokens to count toward cumulative thresholds if Northpoint converts within 30 days. Please add that clause to the SOW.
- SLA rollback language: we will ask for a 7-day rollback trigger during the canary window and specific downtime credit formula; your proposed pro-rated credit sounds acceptable if spelled out.

I'll attach a short SOW draft and our procurement contact details. Can you generate a DocuSign powerform once the SOW includes the soft-commit → hard-commit flow? We are targeting a signature by Nov 20 if possible.

Sara

Attachments: Northpoint-SOW-redwood-draft.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@northpointretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged adoption & pricing ladder for MAP deliverables

Sara — appreciate the fast turnaround. Confirming next steps and ownership: 

1) We will convert pilot tokens to cumulative credit if NPR signs within 30 days (clause to be added to SOW).
2) Canary (M1–M2) will be soft-commit: overage at 1.5x list max, no financial penalties beyond overage billing. Hard commit starts Month 3 (as procurement requested).
3) SLA rollback: we will include a 7-day rollback trigger with the pro-rated downtime credit formula in SOW.
4) Marissa will attach the final SOW stub and pricing ladder and publish a DocuSign powerform.

Action items: Marissa to publish DocuSign + attach HubSpot deal record; Vivek to schedule kick-off call for Nov 24.

Thanks — talk soon.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
